title: The Paper Orchard
author: Orsen Quintana
blurb: Odile Nystrom, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
